ms.promise:
・Detailed architectural documentation for integrating Cardano with IoT, including components and data flow for all 5 Project templates.
・A basic working prototype with functionalities such as data transmission, validation, and storage on the blockchain for all 5 Project templates.
・Development and deployment guide for the prototype for all 5 Project templates.
ms.criteria:
・Completed architectural document clearly describing the system and integration process for all 5 projects
・A stable prototype successfully performing data transmission, validation, and storage for all 5 projects
・Source code free of critical errors, accompanied by detailed instructions.
ms.report:
A. Output: System architecture documents with data flow diagrams for all 5 IoT–Cardano projects
Acceptance criteria: Each document includes system overview, component architecture diagram, data flow diagrams for all major operations, smart contract design (Aiken/Plutus v3), technology stack breakdown, and security considerations.
Evidence:
・IoT1 - DHT22 Sensor Data
・IoT2 - Smart Lock State Sync
・IoT3 - Vending Machines
・IoT4 - Student NFC Identity
・IoT5 - QR Code Supply Chain

B. Output: Working prototypes with demonstration videos showing real-time IoT-to-Cardano data flow for all 5 projects
Acceptance criteria: Each video demonstrates hardware setup, real-time data collection from sensors/devices, data transmission to Cardano blockchain, on-chain validation and storage confirmation, and data retrieval/verification.
Evidence:
・IoT1 - DHT22 Sensor Data
・IoT2 - Smart Lock State Sync
・IoT3 - Vending Machines
・IoT4 - Student NFC Identity
・IoT5 - QR Code Supply Chain

C. Output: Public repository with full source code, deployment guides, and implementation instructions for all 5 projects
Acceptance criteria: Each project includes step-by-step installation/configuration instructions, full source code with dependencies, environment variable templates (.env.example), smart contract source code (Aiken validators), and hardware wiring diagrams.
Evidence:
・GitHub Repository - cardano-iot-example
・IoT1 README | TypeScript, Python, Mesh SDK, Blockfrost
・IoT2 README | Aiken, TypeScript, Bun, Mesh SDK
・IoT3 README | C++, PlatformIO, ArduinoJson, TinyCBOR
・IoT4 README | Python, PyCardano, NFC (PN532), CIP-25
・IoT5 README | Next.js, Aiken, Mesh SDK, CIP-68

All evidence is publicly available at:
・Source code repo: https://github.com/htlabs-xyz/cardano-iot-example
・PoA documentation: https://github.com/htlabs-xyz/Project-Catalyst/tree/main/1300008/Milestone%202

ms.criteria:

ms.report:
A. Output: Testing logs (images and videos capturing evidence of the testing process) for all 5 IoT–Cardano projects
Acceptance criteria: The prototype performs stably and efficiently in real-world testing scenarios. Each testing log includes the test environment, a structured test-case table (expected result / actual result / status), real-world scenario execution, reliability runs with explicit run counts, and links to supporting evidence (demonstration video, Cardano transaction hash, serial-monitor / terminal log).
Evidence:
・IoT1 - DHT22 Sensor Data · Demo video
・IoT2 - Smart Lock State Sync · Demo video
・IoT3 - Vending Machines · Demo video
・IoT4 - Student NFC Identity · Demo video
・IoT5 - QR Code Supply Chain · Demo video

B. Output: Issue Resolution Documents (identified issues, their causes, and proposed solutions) for all 5 IoT–Cardano projects
Acceptance criteria: Issues are identified with clear cause analysis and solutions. Each document includes issue identification, severity classification, observed symptom, root-cause analysis, the applied fix or optimization, and verification evidence (re-test, transaction hash, or runtime log) proving the issue is resolved.
Evidence:
・IoT1 - DHT22 Sensor Data
・IoT2 - Smart Lock State Sync
・IoT3 - Vending Machines
・IoT4 - Student NFC Identity
・IoT5 - QR Code Supply Chain

C. Output: Performance Metrics Reports (comparison of performance before and after optimizations) for all 5 IoT–Cardano projects
Acceptance criteria: Optimizations lead to measurable improvements in performance and reliability. Each report includes a before/after metrics table with the measurement method and an evidence link, plus a reliability table (run count / passed / success rate) for the key real-world scenarios.
Evidence:
・IoT1 - DHT22 Sensor Data
・IoT2 - Smart Lock State Sync
・IoT3 - Vending Machines
・IoT4 - Student NFC Identity
・IoT5 - QR Code Supply Chain

All evidence is publicly available at:
・Source code repo: https://github.com/htlabs
